instruction: Candid documentary photograph, eye-level full shot. In a training dojo with a textured brown wall, the standing woman in the black gi (R1) leans forward to control the leg of the girl in the pink gi (R2). The girl in the pink gi (R2) is inverted on her back on the black mat, legs extended upward in a defensive guard position. The standing woman in the black gi (R1) maintains her balance while gripping her opponent's pants. Soft indoor lighting illuminates the grappling partners, creating a focused athletic atmosphere.
